notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! REWRITTEN CODE
notes.content:
-Basically redid entire airplane script/physics/GUI
-GUI now features homing missiles and bullets that are much easier to target.
-Features AI enemy and Friendly ( push i for automatic pilot)
-Reduced ALL but 2 worlds (Terra/Space)
-Settings and Sound are gone for now
-Free Flight Removed for now
-Multiplayer will NOT WORK (For now)
-Added Back Shopui and fixed the crate glitch

notes.title: QOL UPDATE FAST SLOWMO NOW AVAILABLE !!!!
notes.content:
Rewrote most of the code to take place under 1 scene for the LevelFinder so to reduce the size of game.  Also added settings to make game run faster or slower using time.deltatime. Note doubling maxs at 8x and reducing mins at 0.015625x.

Temporarily removed the shopui to patch later.(Your items are safe with you in steam)
